_source: Traykova, Bellini, Ferreira, Garcia-Garcia, Noller, Zumalacarregui, arXiv:2103.11195v3 (27 Oct 2021), Phys. Rev. D.
_note: Transcribed by hand from Eq. (25) and Eq. (26). Basis: X1 = alphaB_hat, X2 = m alphaB_hat^(1/6), X3 = w0 m^(1/4), X4 = wa m^2. Used by `ssprior gaussianise --reference`. Exact agreement is NOT expected: different Boltzmann code, possibly different f(z) and z_rec computations, and an unpublished Lagrangian prior box.

lambda_free._note: Not reproducible with EFTCAMB: its designer shift-symmetric model has a single DE component with a CPL equation of state and cannot represent Omega_DE = Omega_phi + Omega_Lambda with w = w_phi. Kept here for reference only.
